unresolved.question: Page legend (odd-page style) lists only ক কলকলাহ, শ শিষ, গ গুন্নাহ, ম মোটা, ২ ইখফা, ∧ আরবী সাকিন; band ২ labelled ইখফা (each sits over a noon sakin or tanween before an ikhfa letter), digits ১/৩/৪/৬ use the default labels.
The ৬ printed beside each ringed-wedge at ayah ends (78:1, 2, 3, 4, 5) sits over the madd letter before the final letter; recorded as plain ৬ with the default label.
Band ১ printed inside a single ring over the final alif of tanween at ayah ends recorded as enclosure circle with the label দম ফেলিলে এক আলিফ.
Waqf signs over the 78:7, 78:13 and 78:21 circles are a small ص with a لا-like mark above it (صلے style); 78:11 shows a plain small ص. All encoded as ۖ.
Row 5: the م of مَآءً is cut off at the right page edge; the word is completed from the text (maddah on alif and fathatan on hamza are visible).
Row 7: the shadda over the first و of وَّفُتِحَتِ is partly cut at the page edge; written with shadda + fatha.
Row 4: শ, ম and ১ are printed together over الْمُعْصِرٰتِ; শ anchored to ص, ম and ১ to رٰ by x position.
Row 4 Bengali: the last word at the right edge reads মেঘমাল…; written as মেঘমালা (the final kar is cut off).
Row 8: the ১ over لِّلطَّاغِيْنَ sits over a full alif after طّ, so the word is written with a plain alif, not a superscript alif.
QR codes beside rows 0 and 5, the para box (পারা ৩০), the running heads, the footer label '৭৮ সূরা নাবা' and the 'মানযিল-৭' label are not encoded.
